Which diabetic patients are missing recommended care? Diabetes Care-Gap Tracker
What this is: Which diabetic patients are missing recommended care, and how is the clinic doing on the quality measures health plans pay for? This tracker follows 7 HEDIS-style diabetes measures against targets and produces a prioritized outreach worklist for care coordinators.

Synthetic data only. Synthea-generated patients (seed 20261025); no real people. Measures are HEDIS-style approximations, not certified NCQA HEDIS. Targets are illustrative. Measurement year 2025 shown in tiles; data through 2026-10-25.

How to read this

How to read this: blue = meets target, orange = misses target (MY2025, full year). The gray tile is the size of the 2026 outreach worklist. For “A1c > 9%”, lower is better.
